description: Current spot price for one or more crypto tokens by ticker (BTC, ETH, SOL, ...), CoinGecko id, or chain:address, up to 50 per call. Sourced live from DefiLlama across every major chain. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base) from the wallet configured in the X402SCRAPE_WALLET_KEY environment variable, up to a total session cap (X402SCRAPE_MAX_SPEND_USDC, default $1.00).

coins.description: Comma-separated tickers (BTC,ETH,SOL), coingecko ids, or chain:address
